name: sync
context_rationale: Requires the full vault and project context (ADRs, triage.json, existing component/contract/schema files, slice history) to detect drift and regenerate code-derived views; drift resolution in Step 5 is interactive.
summary: Heavy-mode-only bidirectional vault-code reconciliation skill. Generates code-derived vault files (components/*.md, contracts/*.md, schemas/*.md) fresh from code AST/OpenAPI/type definitions, and detects drift in human-authored vault files. Also runs the cross-spec parity audit (CSP-1) via scripts.lib.cross_spec_parity_audit. Appends a sync record to sync-log.json.

reads.purpose: Verify mode is Heavy before proceeding
Read for CSP-1 audit and drift detection
Read for CSP-1 audit (REQ-NN status fields and implementation references)
Read for CSP-1 audit (NFR-NN status fields and verification references)
Drift check: verify ADR-claimed libraries still in dependencies
Drift check: verify 'retired' risk claims still valid

outputs.purpose: Code-derived component view regenerated from AST; human-authored sections preserved
Code-derived contract view regenerated from OpenAPI/route annotations; human commentary preserved
Code-derived schema view regenerated from data models; state-transition diagrams preserved
Append a dated sync record (mode, files regenerated, drift findings, resolutions)
Fresh AST code graph built in Step 1; used for all regeneration and drift detection
